keyVerseDR: "For the Son of man also is not come to be ministered unto: but to minister..." (Mk 10:45)

level1.title: Jesus Came to Serve
level1.story: James and John asked for the best seats in heaven. Jesus said, "Whoever wants to be great must serve." Jesus came to serve and give His life for us.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did James and John want?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me serve like You. Amen.

activity.title: Servant stamps
activity.intro: Stamp or draw a star each time you serve someone.

level2.title: To Serve, Not to Be Served
level2.story: James and John came to Jesus and asked to sit at His right and left in His glory. Jesus asked, "Can you drink of the chalice that I drink of?" The other ten were angry at James and John. Jesus called them and said, "Whosoever will be greater, shall be your minister." He said, "For the Son of man also is not come to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give His life a redemption for many."
level2.keyLine: The Son of man is not come to be ministered unto, but to minister.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can you serve without being noticed?
level2.prayer: Jesus, teach me to serve and give. Amen.

activity.title: James' diary
activity.intro: Pretend you are James. Write in your diary after talking to Jesus.
